Predators

Orange triangles hunt green prey. Injured prey show a health bar; square remains can be eaten by predators. Below 35% available energy, predators may also hunt each other if prey runs out. Set 0 for a predator-free comparison.

Neural controller

Active: rule-based foraging (0 networks).

0 = rule-based hunting and escape. Neural networks receive a Goal turn node and can influence turning, speed, attack, feeding, and reproduction; visible food, threats, walls, and exploration goals guide movement. Weights start random and evolve through inheritance and mutation, not lifetime learning. Larger brains cost more energy and may perform worse.
